title: Garmin Forerunner 265 Smartwatch US$230.76 (~A$325), Forerunner 255 US$159.95 (~A$225) Delivered @ Aussie Electron AliExpress
body:
Deal: Garmin Forerunner 265 Smartwatch US$230.76 (~A$325), Forerunner 255 US$159.95 (~A$225) Delivered @ Aussie Electron AliExpress

[Clear] Fortunately Ship from AU means the GST is 0% :)
[Lizard Spock] No, it's Pauline Pantsdown that doesn't like anything anything anything… 🎶 My language has been murdered, my shopping trolley murdered. 🎶
[jv] Pauline Pantsdown
huh?
Is that some kind of sexist remark ?
[McMaferMur] I don't understand why Garmin created a model just for running. All their other models can track running just fine, right?
[tpopi] Usually because it's lighter than other garmin watches " Uses durable, lightweight materials optimized for comfort during long-distance training."
[bleeder] This is the reason I went for Polar years ago when I ran a marathon, I wanted something light with a good battery that just did the shit I needed for running and nothing else.
[toddls] There’s tonnes of overlap between their lines - FR970 and Fenix 8 are almost the same watch in a different case. It’s not just for running, it’s just the one they target at runners.
[JustValerie] Anyone has experience with this seller…?
I am after white one, this one is damn appealing.. Delivery in October but I can live with it…
Top Sales Garmins Forerunner 265 Running Smartwatch
$320 AUD
[Clear] Scam. Looking at store feedback there is none. Plus the store location is Brazil. It should always be China or Hong Kong.
[JustValerie] Thank you for confirming my doubts! Really appreciate your feedback and observations, your Garmin posts have been amazing and super useful!
[bamzero] I'm getting "This product can't be shipped to your address.". Metro WA.
Is that their way of making it OOS without saying its OOS?
[Clear] I've found that if you add your address to your account, then it will work.
[bamzero] Yeh, logged in and address is set. Seems it's just WA and NT, changing to any other state makes it available.
[Clear] Thanks. Just pinged AliExpress for them to go yell at the store :)
[porleng] Login to your aliexpress account and add your delivery address then it should work.
[hawkeye93] Weird, I managed to buy it and ship to Metro WA just few minutes ago.
[hawkeye93] yeah very likely, but other stores still have items can't be shipped to WA (one of the Forerunner 255).
[stratbargain] EDIT - This was for the 255. Says it doesn't fit the 265.
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0BJDSBFNP
I got these the other day and have been happy so far. Fits perfect, and you can't really tell it's on there. Not sure how durable they are but will protect from scratches and 4 for $10 you can just replace them if they break.
[SoccerPianist] How does the PayPal discount work? When I go to PayPal checkout it still says $277 USD?
[Jhonka] It should auto apply the paypal discount.
Did you put the promo code in?
AUNS35
[SoccerPianist] Was really odd. Worked for me using the app. Didn't work previously. I did the exact same process…
[rohichan] Any reco for a small wrist (male) - around 40mm?
[bamzero] I'm keeping an eye out for something smaller for the missus. The 265S is 41mm vs 46mm of the 265.
[SoccerPianist] As a small wrist male I tried my sister's FR265s (42mm). It was really comfy, but wore too small/feminine for me liking.
I typically wear a 40mm Seiko 5.
From my research I worked out the FR165 (43mm) should wear slightly bigger on the wrist than it actually is. It is also a bit thinner than the FR265 so will be more comfy to sleep with I hope. I've ordered the FR165 music version - can keep you posted when I get it!
[willyroo] Great price on the 255 as well. Mine's still in great shape after ~4 years.
Only real difference between this 255 and the 265 is no music and the MIPS screen.
[Rocah11] I just tried again and it worked. Thanks!
[JieZ] The cheaper version is gone? I saw both 265 one is black today $431 and black $381 (which is gone)? What is the difference?
[hawkeye93] cheaper one was available earlier today?
[hawkeye93] yeah but I have not seen the cheaper available for a while though.
[JieZ] @hawkeye93: I guess I will wait and see since there is still about $50 difference.
[monkeyoutlet] Why is it saying 'This item can't be shipped to the selected region.'

TCB UK tracked at approx. $129
Plus will get $15 with Team Ozbargain.
Net price approx. $183.
[aec] but you used a promotion code not listed on TCB UK site?
[freedomofspeech] If you buy more items, there are other good discounts on aliexpress currently
[gfunk zero] bit dodgy buying a Garmin off AliExpress? Could be fake or grey import, no mention of warranty on that page
[Pacify] Brand tagged items are sold directly from the official store (or at least from a authorised seller when its not the brand directly)
